Create only this new English audit JSON

scope.root_directory_resolved_path_policy: Only regular leaves whose realpath remains inside one of the exact allowlisted roots were read. No symlink directory was followed.
scope.size_scope: Full SHA256 and ELF header audit for all 20 regular executable leaves at least 10 MiB. Metadata/header-only observation of six 1-10 MiB companion ELF leaves; no cleanup proposed for those companion fixtures.
scope.local_complete_copy_search: Static filename/byte-size inventory under artifacts, dist and tmp. Local hash reads were limited to the three existing exact native Aidoku ELF recovery leaves.
scope.bounds: No remote duplicate search outside the exact old build roots and no fresh tests, builds, apps, probes, rendering or images.

method.remote_read: Python standard-library os.lstat, os.path.realpath, read of first 64 bytes, streaming hashlib.sha256 and os.statvfs via ssh test-env. These operations do not execute any target ELF.
method.local_read: PowerShell Get-Item, Get-FileHash and static rg text/filename queries; 20 shared leaf/ancestor paths of the three recovery files were checked for ReparsePoint and none were found.
method.source_recovery_interpretation: Complete duplicate bytes are required for historical frozen ELF recovery. The audit does not infer regeneration from a current Cargo source checkout or historical partial source pointer.

storage_summary.reclamation_boundary: Single-link allocated bytes are a proposal only. This audit does not check open-file retention or establish actual reclaimed blocks or completion headroom.
storage_summary.correction_of_interim_estimate: The precise 20-ELF total is 1,962,532,864 allocated bytes; the earlier informal approximately 2.08 GB message must not be used as a precise sum.
